title.narrative: Apprasial for project document on The Fund for Cultural Partnerships and Exchange: An initiative under Africa's Century (2025-2028)

description.narrative: The purpose of the assignment is for an external apprasial of the project 'The Fund for Cultural Partnerships and Exchange: An initiative under Africa's Century'. The purpose of the appraisal assignment is to contract a consultant to assess the? content, effectiveness, and organisational set-up of the proposed Fund for Cultural Partnerships and Exchang?e - an initiative under 'Africa's Century'. This is to be done based on relevant Danish strategies and guidelines; 'The World We Share', 'Foreign and Security Policy Strategy' and 'Africa's Century', and Danida guidelines - as well as general knowledge of culture initiatives. Based on this, the appraisal team will provide recommendations to AFRPOL/KOM on any needed adjustments to the project document, to be considered and adjusted prior to further ?approval.?
